name: oxo-flow-venus
title: Tumor multi-omics WGS/WES: somatic SNV/indel, CNV, SV, MSI and signature analysis with bulk/scRNA-seq cohort clinical reporting
description: Tumor multi-omics pipeline covering the full path from raw FASTQ to a cohort clinical report with an auto-generated methods section. DNA chain: BWA-MEM2 alignment with MarkDuplicates and BQSR, Mutect2 somatic SNV/indel calling in paired and tumor-only modes with orientation-bias filtering, CNVkit copy-number profiles, ASCAT purity/ploidy fits, AmpliconSuite ecDNA classification, Manta SVs, MSIsensor MSI and in-house SBS96/COSMIC signature fits, annotated with vep-rs and tiered by CIViC-based clinical interpretation. RNA chain: two-pass STAR + featureCounts bulk RNA-seq with fusion screening, dnbc4tools single-cell counting, and SpecHLA -> VEP -> pVACseq/pVACfuse neoantigen prediction. Cohort reports (TMB, clinical evidence tables, MSI/frameshift and ICB pages) aggregate exactly the runs that executed, per the engine rule_runs checkpoint.

installation.engine: oxo-flow >= 0.24 (README Requirements; the [engine] disk-pressure guard additionally needs engine commit a456c796+ — oxo-flow PR #845)
installation.toolchain: pixi — pinned per-rule environments in envs/*/pixi.toml (pixi.lock present for all modules except arcas); resolved into .oxo-flow/pixi/ at run time
requirements: Reference data (exact keys in venus.oxoflow [config]): GRCh38 FASTA with UCSC-style chr-prefixed contigs (chr1..chrX, chrM) + BWA-MEM2 index, STAR index + GENCODE GTF, GATK resource bundle (dbsnp/mills/gnomad/PoN), vep-rs binary + JSON cache, single-cell reference for dnbc4tools, CNVkit normal reference for tumor-only CNV
pixi on PATH (workflow environments resolve per rule into .oxo-flow/pixi/)

cohort inputs: raw/{sample}_R1.fastq.gz / _R2.fastq.gz in the run workdir; cohort declared in config/pairs.tsv (paired and tumor-only pairs may mix, gated per pair) and config/groups.tsv (assay column drives the wgs/rnaseq/scrna per-sample gating)
